content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To be optimistic in a pessimistic world, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Share your renewed perspective with a friend (15 minutes)
Step 2. Identify one recurring negative thought pattern (1 hour)
Step 3. Research the benefits of a growth mindset (2 hours)
Step 4. Unsubscribe from sensationalist news alerts (10 minutes)
Step 5. Practice a guided visualization on future success (20 minutes)
Step 6. List three things you are grateful for today (5 minutes)
Step 7. Write a letter of encouragement to your future self (30 minutes)
Step 8. Perform one small anonymous act of kindness (30 minutes)
Step 9. Read a biography of a resilient historical figure (1 week)
Step 10. Meditate on the concept of radical acceptance (45 minutes)
Step 11. Create a "positivity portfolio" of past achievements (4 hours)
Step 12. Set a long-term goal that excites you (1 hour)
Step 13. Organize your physical workspace for clarity (2 hours)
Step 14. Spend an afternoon in a natural, peaceful setting (4 hours)
Step 15. Listen to an uplifting podcast episode (1 hour)
Step 16. Identify a personal strength you often overlook (30 minutes)
Step 17. Reflect on a past hardship that led to personal growth (2 hours)
Step 18. Practice saying "no" to draining social obligations (5 minutes)
Step 19. Start a dream journal to track subconscious desires (1 week)
Step 20. Commit to a week-long "complaint fast" (7 days)
Step 21. Forgive someone who caused you minor stress (1 hour)
Step 22. Limit your daily social media scrolling time (30 minutes)
Step 23. Watch a documentary about human cooperation (90 minutes)
Step 24. Acknowledge that you cannot control everything (10 minutes)
Step 25. Compliment a stranger sincerely (2 minutes)
Step 26. Define your core personal values (3 hours)
Step 27. Frame your "optimism manifesto" and hang it up (1 hour)
Step 28. Volunteer for a cause you believe in (5 hours)
Step 29. Smile at yourself in the mirror for one minute (1 minute)
Step 30. Write down five positive affirmations (15 minutes)
Step 31. Clean out your digital inbox and files (3 hours)
Step 32. Curate a music playlist that boosts your mood (1 hour)
Step 33. Spend a morning observing small joys in a park (3 hours)
Step 34. Read a book on cognitive behavioral techniques (10 days)
Step 35. Attend a community workshop or lecture (2 hours)
Step 36. Evaluate your current circle of influence (2 hours)
Step 37. Mentor someone who is struggling (2 hours)
Step 38. Journal about your ideal "best possible" self (45 minutes)
Step 39. Reframe a specific pessimistic thought into a neutral one (15 minutes)
Step 40. Delete apps that trigger feelings of inadequacy (10 minutes)
Step 41. Conduct a "positivity audit" of your digital life (1 hour)
Step 42. Donate items you no longer need to charity (3 hours)
Step 43. Replace one "I have to" with "I get to" in speech (1 day)
Step 44. Cook a healthy meal from scratch (90 minutes)
Step 45. Take a long, relaxing bath or shower (30 minutes)
Step 46. Spend time playing with a pet or visiting an animal shelter (2 hours)
Step 47. Wake up early to watch a sunrise (1 hour)
Step 48. Watch an inspiring TED talk (20 minutes)
Step 49. Buy yourself a small bouquet of flowers (15 minutes)
Step 50. Practice deep breathing exercises (10 minutes)
Step 51. Write a thank-you note to a former teacher (20 minutes)
Step 52. Set boundaries for discussing negative topics (15 minutes)
Step 53. Visualize a positive outcome for a current challenge (15 minutes)
Step 54. Learn a new, small skill just for fun (2 hours)
Step 55. Establish a consistent evening wind-down routine (1 hour)
Step 56. Reflect on the beauty of human imperfection (1 hour)
Step 57. Create a vision board of your aspirations (3 hours)
Step 58. Find a mantra to repeat during stressful moments (5 minutes)
Step 59. Block out time for a hobby you love (2 hours)
Step 60. Drink a glass of water and stretch (10 minutes)
